svg.title: What happens when you click Buy
svg.desc: What happens when you click Buy. The shop contains Website, Orders, Stock. Payment provider contains Card check, Your bank. You → Website: Buy. Website → Orders: new order. Orders → Stock: reserve. Orders → Card check: charge. Card check → Your bank: approve?. Your bank → Card check: yes. Card check → Orders: paid. Orders → Receipt. Note on card->bank: the slow part: 1–3 seconds.

g.text: What happens when you click Buy
